exposure: Phenotypic markers of undifferentiated connective tissue dysplasia (UCTD) in mothers
phenotypic markers of undifferentiated connective tissue dysplasia (UCTD)
Infants with neonatal respiratory distress syndrome (NRDS)
cohort: 100 pregnant women (50 with phenotypic markers of UCTD and 50 without)
finding: Neonatal respiratory distress syndrome and bronchopulmonary dysplasia were more common in premature infants born to mothers with phenotypic markers of undifferentiated connective tissue dysplasia.
mod_finding: This study does not report findings on mode of delivery, although it does note the rates of cesarean delivery in the study groups.
